# ONNX Runtime STFT fixtures

These fixtures are generated by `tools/generate_ort_fixtures.py` with the
official ONNX Runtime 1.27.0 Python package and `CPUExecutionProvider`. The
generator first audits the sole STFT node and exact window bits in the pinned
prepared model, then verifies the baked forward-DFT root tables against nearest
float32 mathematical roots. Graph optimization is disabled and both thread
counts are pinned to one.

The cases cover the minimum `L=20`, an incomplete tail at `L=24`, and the exact
second-frame boundary at `L=25`, including batch two. Each adjacent JSON file
records complete provenance, shape/sign/component conventions, coefficient and
fixture SHA-256 digests.

The binary header is little-endian `<8s5I`: magic `KORSTFT1`, format version,
batch, signal length, frame count, and output element count. It is followed by
the contiguous little-endian float32 `[B, frames, 11, 2]` output.

Regenerate with:

```sh
/tmp/trueos-kokoro-lstm-ort127/bin/python \
  crates/trueos-kokoro/stft/tools/generate_ort_fixtures.py
```

Use `--verify` under another runtime to cross-check without rewriting the
stable provenance. The local custom/pre-release ONNX Runtime 1.28.0 environment
produced bit-identical output for all 154 fixture floats.
